categories.name: Gameplay Settings
categories.description: To change the way you play

options.name: Downscroll
options.description:
If checked, notes go Down instead of Up,
simple enough.

options.name: Middlescroll
options.description:
Centers your strumline. Splits opponent
strumline to the far left and right.

options.name: Opponent Strums
options.description: Show the opponent's receptors.

options.name: Opponent Notes
options.description:
Show the opponent's notes.
Requires Opponent Strums enabled.

options.name: Ghost Tapping
options.description:
If checked, you won't get misses from
pressing keys while there are no notes able to hit.

options.name: Disable Reset
options.description:
If checked, you won't be able to reset
the song using the Start/Select shortcut.

options.name: Touch Hitboxes
options.description:
Enable touchscreen hitbox controls on the
bottom screen. WARNING: Only 1 note can
be hit at a time (hardware limitation).

options.name: Hitbox Vis
options.description:
When should touch hitboxes be visible?
(Always / On Touch / Hidden)

options.name: Hitbox Style
options.description:
How should touch hitboxes be drawn?
(Full Bars / Borders Only)

options.name: Bot Play
options.description:
If checked, the game plays itself
automatically. Notes are auto-hit.

options.name: Note Underlay
options.description:
Adjust the opacity of the dark background
under the notes strumline.

options.name: Opponent Underlay
options.description:
If checked, shows the dark underlay behind
the opponent strumline too.

options.name: Note Colors
options.description:
Toggle custom note colors.
If disabled, default colors are used.

options.name: Customize Combo
options.description: Adjust combo position, scale, and alpha.

options.name: Time Bar
options.description: What should the Time Bar display?

options.name: Health Bar
options.description: Toggle visibility of the health bar.

options.name: Rate Popups
options.description:
Show Sick!, Good!, Bad!, Shit!
popups when hitting a note.

options.name: Camera Zooms
options.description:
If unchecked, the camera won't zoom
in on a beat hit.

options.name: Score Text Zoom
options.description:
If unchecked, disables the Score text
growing every time you hit a note.

options.name: Flashing Lights
options.description:
Uncheck this if you're sensitive
to the flashing lights!

options.name: Alphabet Pause
options.description:
If checked, uses Alphabet font in
the Pause Menu instead of VCR.

options.name: Check Updates
options.description: If checked, checks for updates on startup.

options.name: Button Prompts
options.description:
If checked, shows button prompts
at the bottom of screens.

options.name: Low Quality
options.description:
If checked, disables some background details,
decreases loading times and improves performance.

options.name: Antialiasing
options.description:
If unchecked, disables anti-aliasing globally,
improving performance at the cost of jagged visuals.

options.name: Fast Notes
options.description:
Changes note rendering to use simple
colored arrows for a less ram usage.

options.name: Draw UI Grid
options.description:
If unchecked, disables the checkerboard grid
on the bottom screen for a small performance boost.

options.name: Debug Info
options.description:
Displays debug information and
performance stats.

options.name: Extended Debug
options.description:
If checked, PlayState debug will also
show model, RAM and VRAM.

options.name: FPS Limit
options.description:
Set the maximum frame rate.
Lowering this can save battery.

categories.name: Note Colors
categories.description:
To customize the colors of the notes
(YOU MUST ACTIVATE NOTE COLORS)
